name: Gadget
description_en:
Gadget is a managed JavaScript development and hosting platform with Postgres-backed models, server-side actions, generated APIs, frontend tools and authentication. Developers implement application logic inside a supplied framework instead of separately assembling every backend and hosting service.

A web template can start with sign-up/sign-in and a live editor preview, but production data access and action behavior still depend on the application. This profile focuses on model actions, background work and environment deployment; Shopify and other connectors are separate integration scopes, not automatic authorization for every custom model.
description_zh:
Gadget 是托管 JavaScript 开发及运行平台，提供 Postgres 模型、服务端 action、生成 API、前端工具及认证。开发者在预置框架内实现业务逻辑，无需分别组装每项后端及托管服务。

网页模板可带注册／登录及编辑器实时预览，但生产数据访问和 action 行为仍取决于应用。本文聚焦模型 action、后台任务及环境部署；Shopify 等连接器另有集成范围，不会自动为每个自定义模型授权。

core_features.explanation_en: Use managed data models with callable actions and queries.
core_features.explanation_zh: 使用托管模型及可调用 action／查询。

core_features.explanation_en: Separate transactional model work from post-commit logic.
core_features.explanation_zh: 区分模型事务操作与提交后逻辑。

core_features.explanation_en: Enqueue asynchronous tasks with configurable retries and queues.
core_features.explanation_zh: 将异步任务入队，配置重试及队列。

core_features.explanation_en: Promote code/model/configuration while databases remain isolated.
core_features.explanation_zh: 发布代码／模型／配置，同时保持数据库隔离。

en: Test post-commit failure, retries and schema deployment separately
zh: 评估有权限范围的库存 action
分别测试提交后故障、重试及 schema 部署

steps.en: Create a disposable auth template and one model/action.
steps.zh: 建立可丢弃认证模板及一个模型／action。

steps.en: Test user, other-tenant and service-key filters.
steps.zh: 测试用户、其他租户及服务 key 过滤。

steps.en: Separate transaction/followup failures, then inspect deployment data effects and costs.
steps.zh: 区分事务／后续故障，再检查部署数据影响及费用。

items.en: Model transactions have an eight-second deadline; onSuccess failures do not undo commits.
items.zh: 模型事务有八秒截止，onSuccess 失败不撤销提交。

items.en: Background retries require business-level duplicate handling.
items.zh: 后台重试需业务级重复处理。

items.en: Environment deployment does not copy rows and schema deletion/recreation can remove data.
items.zh: 环境部署不复制行，schema 删后重建可能移除数据。

Earlier third-party feature and price claims are retained only in discovery provenance, not as current product evidence.

sections.title_en: Build one authenticated operation and inspect its API
sections.title_zh: 构建一个认证操作，检查其 API
sections.en: A proposed inventory application could start from the web-with-auth template, add an Item model and implement a stock adjustment action. Preview sign-in, then call the action through its generated API and inspect both the result and stored row. Actions can be model-scoped or global; choose whether the operation belongs to a record. A signed-in page alone does not establish that direct action calls or another customer’s records are protected. No template or API was run here.
sections.zh: 建议库存应用从带认证网页模板开始，添加 Item 模型，实现库存调整 action。预览登录后，经生成 API 调用，检查返回及存储行。Action 可限模型或全局，应按是否属于记录选择。登录页面本身不能证明 API 直调或另一客户记录受保护。本次未运行模板及 API。

sections.title_en: After-commit errors do not reverse committed data
sections.title_zh: 提交后错误不撤销已提交数据
sections.en: Model action run is transactional by default and has an eight-second transaction deadline, distinct from configurable action timeoutMS. Global actions are nontransactional by default. onSuccess runs after successful commit; its errors do not roll back the earlier transaction. Put slow follow-up work outside the short transaction and design external effects for safe replay. An email/payment failure after a stock update cannot be treated as proof the stock update failed. Test database failure and post-commit failure separately.
sections.zh: 模型 action 的 run 默认事务化，有八秒事务截止，与可配置 action timeoutMS 不同；全局 action 默认非事务。onSuccess 在成功提交后执行，其错误不回滚此前事务。慢后续工作应置于短事务之外，外部副作用需可安全重放。库存更新后的邮件／支付失败不能证明库存更新失败，应分别测试数据库及提交后故障。

sections.title_en: Retries and single concurrency do not mean exactly once
sections.title_zh: 重试及单并发不等于恰好一次
sections.en: The background guide documents up to six retries by default with exponential backoff, configurable per enqueue. A named queue can restrict concurrency; a stable ID and duplicate-ID behavior can prevent repeated enqueueing. It specifically notes that a retried parent may enqueue its children again. Choose IDs based on the business operation and handle duplicate external work, rather than equating a single-concurrency queue with deduplication. Review final-attempt logs and test partial completion before relying on automated retries.
sections.zh: 后台指南列默认最多六次指数退避重试，入队时可配置。命名队列可限制并发，稳定 ID 及重复 ID 行为可防重复入队；指南特别提示父任务重试可能再次加入子任务。应按业务操作选 ID，处理外部重复，不能把单并发队列等同去重。依赖自动重试前需检查最后尝试日志并测试部分完成。

sections.title_en: Tenant filters must cover custom models too
sections.title_zh: 租户过滤也必须覆盖自定义模型
sections.en: Access control combines action/role permission with Gelly model filters. API-key calls have no User or Session, so a filter using session identity can see null and return no data. Shopify-owned models receive connection-managed filters, while custom models need their own filters for the same shop isolation. Test two tenants and a service-key caller directly. Do not infer isolation from a template’s sign-in screen or from default connector filters on unrelated tables.
sections.zh: 访问控制结合 action／角色及 Gelly 模型过滤。API key 调用没有 User／Session，依赖会话身份的过滤会得到 null 并可能无结果。Shopify 所有模型有连接器管理过滤，自定义模型则需自行添加同类店铺隔离。应直接测试两个租户及服务 key，不能从模板登录页或无关表的默认过滤推断隔离。

sections.title_en: Deploying a schema is not copying development records
sections.title_zh: 部署 schema 不等于复制开发记录
sections.en: Development and production databases are isolated; deploying or cloning copies code/model/configuration, not database contents. Required seed/config records need a deliberate data path. The deployment guide warns that deleting/recreating a model or field changes its storageKey and can create empty production storage even with the same API name. It also says rollback is not built in: use a known source-control version and redeploy. A limited storageKey retention window is not a universal backup guarantee. No migration or recovery was attempted.
sections.zh: 开发与生产数据库隔离，部署／克隆复制代码／模型／配置，不复制数据，必需初始／配置记录需明确数据路径。部署指南警告删后重建模型或字段会改变 storageKey，即使 API 名相同，也可能产生空生产存储；还说明没有内置回滚，需用已知源码版本重新部署。有限 storageKey 保留窗口不是通用备份保证。本次未执行迁移或恢复。

sections.title_en: The plan has several resource meters
sections.en: Current pricing lists Hobby $0 forever, Pro $35/month and Premium $350/month. Hobby allows two seats, 10 CPU hours, 0.5 GB data and 500K platform credits; its 100 AI credits are on sign-up, not a verified monthly refill. Pro lists ten seats, 30 CPU hours, 3 GB data and one million platform credits, plus additional production-environment pricing. CPU, storage/search, database read/write compute, edge bandwidth and platform operations are separate meters. Confirm overages, AI refills and billing scope; do not turn a seat allowance into a per-user fee or assume unlimited hosting.
sections.zh: 当前定价列 Hobby 永久 $0、Pro 每月 $35、Premium $350。Hobby 含两席位、十 CPU 小时、0.5 GB 数据及五十万平台积分，一百 AI 积分为注册时，不是已确认每月补充。Pro 列十席位、三十 CPU 小时、3 GB 数据及一百万平台积分，还列额外生产环境计价。CPU、数据／搜索、数据库读写算力、边缘带宽及平台操作分别计量。需确认超额、AI 补充及计费范围，不能把席位额度转成每用户价或假设托管不限。

sections.title_en: Source control and application ownership need an exit plan
sections.title_zh: 源码与应用所有权需要退出方案
sections.en: Gadget fits evaluation by JavaScript teams that want a supplied backend/runtime and can work within its action/model conventions. Terms distinguish user content from service rights and require users to maintain copies. Access to app source is not proof the entire hosted platform is open source or that an export runs unchanged elsewhere. Verify backup, external-service configuration, runtime portability and release restoration for the application. UI languages, actual throughput and production recovery were not tested.
sections.zh: 希望使用预置后端／运行环境、愿按 action／模型约定开发的 JavaScript 团队可评估 Gadget。条款区分用户内容与服务权利，并要求用户保留副本。可访问应用源码不能证明完整托管平台开源，也不能证明导出后可原样在别处运行。需核对备份、外部配置、运行可移植及发布恢复；界面语言、实际吞吐及生产恢复未测试。
